665:t_001:48.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain. The Galactic Raid Fleet, including the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3, has reportedly begun moving toward the center as well.」

665:t_001:49.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, and the fleet that went to support them are probably heading for the galaxy's center, too.」

665:t_001:50.en:
$$キャシー$$
「That's where the nest of the $$宇宙怪獣$$ is... the enemy we must defeat...」

665:t_001:51.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I detect a gravitational tremor. Something is about to appear in this sector.」

665:t_002:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$!」

665:t_002:3.en:
$$レド$$
「It seems we've already entered their territory!」

665:t_003:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「It looks like they mean to stop us from reaching their nest!」

665:t_003:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We'll raise hell to create a diversion for $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3!」

665:t_003:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「I got it! Those are orders I'm happy to take!」

665:t_003:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Heh...! This is like round one of the final showdown! Let's make it quick!」

665:t_003:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, attack! Finish them quickly to protect the $$フロンティア船団$$ behind us!」

665:t_004:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I've confirmed a group of units approaching this area!」

665:t_005:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Those $$バジュラ$$! Are they the ones controlled by the $$ギャラクシー船団$$?!」

665:t_006:1.en:
$$クラン$$
「It seemed to join up with the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s forces after the battle at the $$霧の海$$, but...」

665:t_006:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「There are so many...! Has the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ joined forces with the $$人類銀河同盟$$?!」

665:t_006:3.en:
$$ルカ$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$! I'll send you the data we've gathered. Please analyze it for us!」

665:t_006:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have completed the analysis. Those $$マシンキャリバー$$s differ in some details from those of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

665:t_006:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I estimate that they are mass-produced replicas based on $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#robot$$.」

665:t_006:7.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「We are the $$人類支援啓蒙レギュレーションシステム$$...」

665:t_006:9.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「We are a system that exists to enlighten humanity and guide it toward a better existence...」

665:t_006:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's saying the same thing as the $$ストライカー#pilot$$ we fought at the $$霧の海$$!」

665:t_006:11.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Like the machines, that interface was probably duplicated and installed in each unit.」

665:t_006:12.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Every one of them has an AI aboard that calls itself a god?!」

665:t_006:13.en:
$$クラン$$
「Why would something like that cooperate with the $$ギャラクシー船団$$...?!」

665:t_006:15.en:
$$オズマ$$
「What do you mean, $$ブレラ$$?!」

665:t_006:16.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The $$人類銀河同盟$$ treats humans as components of society, pursuing rationality and efficiency.」

665:t_006:17.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「That is the same concept as the $$ギャラクシー船団$$, which used $$インプラント$$ technology to rationalize and streamline both society and humanity.」

665:t_006:18.en:
$$レド$$
「Is $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$ helping them to make its own ideals a reality?!」

665:t_006:19.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And now that the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ has obtained the $$バジュラ$$'s power, its goal is...」

665:t_006:20.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「It is probably to use that power to rule the entire galaxy.」

665:t_006:21.en:
$$レド$$
「So that society would be $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$'s ideal world?!」

665:t_006:22.en:
$$シン$$
「The whole universe could be in danger, and they're pulling this selfish crap?!」

665:t_006:23.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Does that mean the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ is also operating near the center of the galaxy...?」

665:t_006:24.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Even so, isn't it a little too convenient that they attacked us just after we transferred here?!」

665:t_006:27.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They're ignoring the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and attacking us. For now, we have no choice but to intercept them.」

665:t_006:28.en:
$$ノノ$$
「We've come so close to the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest, and now humans are fighting each other...!」

665:t_006:29.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「We've come so close to the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest, and now humans are fighting each other...!」

665:t_006:30.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「We've come so close to the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest, and now humans are fighting each other...!」

665:t_006:31.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Focus, $$ノノ$$. If we stop advancing here and now, it will mean the end of Earth!」

665:t_006:33.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Y-yes, I will!」

665:t_006:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it! Do those bastards not care if the universe is destroyed?!」

665:t_006:36.en:
$$レド$$
「Do we... have no choice but to fight...?!」

665:t_007:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I've confirmed the destruction of all the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$ギャラクシー船団$$ units.」

665:t_007:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I expected the $$宇宙怪獣$$, but I never thought the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ would attack us here...」

665:t_008:0.en:
$n
「What the hell are they trying to do...?」

665:t_008:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If we leave $$バアル$$ unchecked, the very existence of this universe is in danger. Why would they do this...?」

665:t_008:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We stopped their ambitions once during the $$再世戦争$$... Perhaps this is their revenge.」

665:t_008:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「They'd ignore the crisis facing the universe and attack us just for that...」

665:t_008:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Even in this situation, they can't let go of their personal grudges.」

665:t_008:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「If you call that human, it's all too human.」

665:t_008:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Their implants grant them power beyond anything an ordinary human possesses...」

665:t_008:7.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...and they have even obtained the $$バジュラ$$'s power and the $$人類銀河同盟$$'s technology.」

665:t_008:8.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Yet they still cannot cast aside the ego that drives them to dominate others and stand at the top.」

665:t_008:10.en:
$$タケル$$
「But that isn't just true of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$. $$ミケーネ$$, Emperor $$ズール$$, and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ are the same.」

665:t_008:11.en:
$$葵$$
「Even with power beyond humanity, in the end they act like humans... and like villains, at that...」

665:t_008:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That isn't a new stage of humanity... It's the ego of those who have gained power.」

665:t_008:13.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「In the end, however far we go, humans are still human...」

665:t_008:15.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, $$バサラ$$! Stop making careless remarks and muddying the issue!」

665:t_008:16.en:
$$バサラ$$
「What are you talking about? If we lost our hearts, we wouldn't even be able to sing.」

665:t_008:18.en:
$$桂$$
「Well... $$バサラ$$ does have a point.」

665:t_008:19.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Basically, villains are villains, whether they're $$バアル$$, a system, or some self-proclaimed gods.」
